Order
This writ petition has been filed seeking issuance of a writ of mandamus directing second respondent to re-determine the compensation awarded to petitioner's lands acquired at Karasur Revenue Village in Award No.2 of 2008, based on application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 dated 10.02.2025, pursuant to the enhanced compensation award passed in L.A.O.P.No.1 of 2017 on the file of II Additional District Judge, Puducherry.
_ _ _ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
By consent of learned counsel on both sides, this writ petition is taken up for final disposal at the admission stage itself.

3. The case of the petitioner is that petitioner's land was acquired for the purpose of setting up of Special Economic Zone by invoking Section 17(4) of Land Acquisition Act, 1894, by the first respondent.
Above acquisition was made based on the request of fourth respondent and a notification under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act came to be published on 24.03.2005.
Acquisition proceeding was completed, petitioner received a communication dated 04.07.2006.
It is stated that petitioner produced all relevant documents to prove the ownership and possession.
The final award came to be passed in Award No.2 of 2008 on 25.01.2008.
Aggrieved by quantum of compensation, one of the land owner preferred an Reference Application seeking enhancement of compensation.
Reference Application was taken on file as L.A.O.P.No.1 of 2017.
The said LAOP was disposed of by enhancing the compensation and granting 30% Solatium and _________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
( Uploaded on: 04/09/2025 08:44:55 pm ) 12% Additional Market Value.
Based on the said award in L.A.O.P.No.1 of 2017, petitioner made an application under Section 28(A) to second respondent seeking to redetermine the compensation awarded to his lands.

However, respondents have not come forward to consider the application and therefore,
petitioner filed the present petition.

4. It is submitted by learned Additional Government Pleader (Puducherry) appearing for respondents that action has already been initiated vide Letter No.622/DCRS/SEZ/B3/2025 dated 07.07.2025 and the same holds good for the present petitioner also with regard to sanction and disbursement of the enhanced compensation under Section 28A of Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

sentences.text: "SPECIAL ECONOMIC ZONE" in Karasur Revenue Village, Villanur Taluk, Puduchery have already submitted representations for enhanced compensation under Section 28A of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 to our office and they are eligible for the disbursement of enhanced compensation under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894:
1. Tmt.R.Kowsalya, W/o.Rajulu 2. Tmt.Usha, D/o.Rajulu, W/o.L.Senthilkumar 3. Thiru.R.Balasubramanian, S/o.Rajulu
In this regard, this office has already initiated the necessary action for the sanction and disbursement of the enhanced compensation u/s.28A of Land Acquisition Act, 1984.
However, the process is presently delayed due to the non-receipt of requisite funds from the requisition department.
This is for your kind information."

5. Learned counsel for petitioner would only request that the application of petitioner may be considered within a specified time to be fixed by this Court to which learned Additional Government Pleader would submit that they would do so as expeditiously as possible.
_ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

6. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case and the stand taken by learned Additional Government Pleader (Puducherry), there shall be a direction to the concerned respondent to consider Section 28(A) application submitted by petitioner and pass appropriate orders within a period of four months from the date of uploading of the web copy without waiting for the receipt of certified copy.

It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any view with regard to the merits of the case and it is open to the concerned respondent to consider the matter on its own merits and in accordance with law.
7. With the above direction, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
No costs.
